verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical, and both are badly broken. The headline is shrunk and spread out: a large gap separates 'CHILDREN'S' from 'DAY', so it no longer reads as one bold title, and it is crammed into the right half. The address is tiny, and the train sits clipped at the bottom with a blue stick and the green dot overlapping it. The only differences are where the green dot and the orange bar are placed. In A the orange bar overlaps the blue block, and in B the green dot sits on the train body. Neither placement is clearly better.
